evidence: We use AI to inform certain of our decisions or to manage our business
The use of artificial intelligence, machine learning technology and other quantitative analysis tools and models, developed by us or third-party service providers

Data center power demand is expected to grow substantially. Data center share of total U.S. power demand is expected to increase from approximately 5% of total U.S. power demand in 2025 to 12% by 2030, with 124 GW of AI capacity added on a cumulative basis between 2025 and 2030
If we are unable to advance our AI capabilities as quickly or as effectively as our competitors, we may be at a competitive disadvantage
ai_positioning.summary: HASI utilise l'IA en interne pour ses décisions d'investissement et opérations, tout en se positionnant comme bénéficiaire indirect de la croissance massive de la demande énergétique des data centers alimentée par l'IA. La société exprime une certaine prudence face aux risques concurrentiels et opérationnels liés à l'IA.
